properties.rationale: User (who:ajs, standing policy from 2026-07-23, applied again 2026-07-25): validation happens through the trials programme — docs/trials/ is where "built the right thing" is exercised against operational intent; formal validation-kind Verification nodes are not this project's tracking mechanism. Re-fired because cap:publish-surface joined the set (45 → 46). The trial here writes itself and is the sharpest one this project has had available: publish reflow2's own surface — ifc:mcp-tools and ifc:graph-export are now designated, so the document is real — hand it to Alex, and see whether he can build against it WITHOUT the repo. That is req:design-reachable-without-the-repo tested by the only person who can test it. What the seven tests cannot tell us is whether the boundary set is RIGHT: a design that designates too little publishes a useless surface, and one that designates too much has published its internals under another name. Only a consumer discovers which.
